sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-AP antibody binding confirmed surface accessibility; ligand stimulation did not affect anti-AP antibody binding, demonstrating ligand-binding function is preserved.
sites.rationale: CXCR4 (UniProt P61073) carries no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–38 as extracellular, making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus. A tag prepended before M1 (insert_after_residue=0) is therefore unambiguously extracellular. The ledger contains at least eight independent clips (L1–L11, L13–L14) reporting N-terminal tags on full-length membrane-anchored CXCR4; L6 is selected as the primary clip because it explicitly confirms both surface accessibility (anti-AP antibody binding) and functional integrity (ligand binding unaffected). No residue number is stated in any clip, so position_evidence is topology_derived: with a single extracellular terminus and no signal peptide, the junction is uniquely M1. AP (acceptor peptide) tag fused at the N terminus of full-length CXCR4 stably expressed in RBL cells; the tag is accessible to anti-AP antibody on the cell surface, and ligand stimulation does not affect anti-AP antibody binding, confirming the tag does not interfere with ligand binding.

sources.claim: Ligand stimulation did not affect anti-AP or anti-receptor antibody binding thus specific interaction between anti-AP antibody and AP-tag does not interfere with ligand-binding.

literature_notes: All sixteen ledger lines converge on two junction classes: (1) N-terminal prepend (L1–L11, L13–L14, L16) — multiple tag types (NLuc, HiBiT, LgBiT, AP, HA, FLAG, Venus-VN) all placed before M1 on the extracellular face, with surface display confirmed by cell-impermeant reagents (L2, L4, L14) and ligand-binding function confirmed (L6); (2) C-terminal fusion (L12, L15) — FLAG and Venus-VC fused after S352, which the topology landmarks place firmly in the intracellular domain (306–352), so these are recorded in other_positions only. No ledger line reports a tag insertion in any extracellular loop (ECL1 97–110, ECL2 176–195, ECL3 262–283), so no internal sites are proposed. The N-terminal site is the only surface-tag site the ledger supports.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG tag fused at the C-terminus of full-length CXCR4 for cryo-EM structural studies; the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (residues 306–352) and is not a surface-tag site.
Venus C-terminal fragment (VC) fused at the C-terminus of full-length CXCR4 for BiFC dimerization studies; intracellular location confirmed by topology landmarks.
